hero.title: KARATE LEGENDS
hero.subtitle: Where legends are forged. The world stage for the best black belts.

summary.title: What is Karate Legends?
summary.text: Karate Legends is an event created to do what karate has always needed: recognize those who dedicate their lives to it. We know there are athletes and senseis who train, invest, and win without anyone outside the dojo knowing. We know because we come from there. That's why, at Karate Legends, each athlete is promoted before the event, followed during, and admired as a reference after. With editions held inside and outside Brazil, live broadcast to several countries, a live audience of hundreds, and international refereeing, the event allows Shotokan and Shito-Ryu styles to demonstrate their techniques freely. Karate Legends is not just a competition. It is the place where the karateka finally receives what they have always deserved.

athletes.title: Selection Process
athletes.subtitle: Become part of the elite. The path to becoming a legend starts here.
athletes.req_1: Brown or Black Belt (Shotokan or Shito-Ryu)
athletes.process_desc: Each application is individually reviewed by the Legends technical consultant, who analyzes the submitted video, graduation certificate, and ID. If selected as eligible, you receive confirmation by email. Approval does not guarantee participation in the next event, but makes the athlete eligible for future calls — Matchups or Grand Prix.
athletes.event_types_desc: Matchups (challenging the champion or a challenger of the category weight) or Grand Prix (tournament to define a new category champion).

faq.q1: What are the minimum requirements to participate?
faq.a1: Be a Shotokan or Shito-Ryu karate brown or black belt, have a highlight video with Kumite and Bassai Dai kata performance, possess a valid graduation certificate, and provide an official photo ID document.
faq.q2: What should the application video contain?
faq.a2: The video should show your best moments in Kumite (fighting) and a technical execution of the Bassai Dai kata. We look for technique, explosiveness, and martial spirit.
faq.q3: How does the analysis fee work?
faq.a3: The fee covers the work of the Legends technical consultant — review of the video, graduation certificate and ID document submitted. Payment is made after the form is sent, via a link emailed to you. Approval does not guarantee participation in the next event, but makes the athlete eligible for future calls.
faq.q4: Will I be notified if selected?
faq.a4: You will only receive an email response if approved, within 10 calendar days of submission. If no response is received within this period, consider the application not approved.

drive_tutorial.title: How to share files via Google Drive
drive_tutorial.intro: To submit your certificate, ID, and video, you need to upload them to Google Drive and share a public link. Follow these steps:
drive_tutorial.step1_desc: Go to drive.google.com and sign in with your Google account.
drive_tutorial.step2_desc: Click "+ New" → "File upload" and select your certificate photo, ID document, or video.
drive_tutorial.step4_desc: Under "General access", change from "Restricted" to "Anyone with the link". Click "Done".
drive_tutorial.step5_desc: Click "Copy link" and paste it in the corresponding form field.

terms.voluntary_title: 2. Voluntary Nature of Submission and Payment
terms.voluntary_text: Registration and payment of the analysis fee are made at the sole initiative of the applicant, voluntarily and spontaneously. The applicant acknowledges that they submit their information, documents and media of their own free will, without any inducement, coercion or promise of approval by the organization.
terms.accuracy_text: The applicant is the sole and exclusive responsible for the truthfulness, authenticity and legality of all data, links, documents, videos and other information submitted. Karate Legends organization has no duty, nor means, to verify the authenticity of each document and therefore assumes no civil or criminal liability for any false, tampered, incomplete or irregular information provided by the applicant.
terms.accuracy_text2: If any irregularity is identified — before, during or after the event — the organization reserves the right to disqualify the athlete at any time, without right to refund and without obligation to previously communicate the reason.
terms.no_notify_text: The organization has no obligation to communicate to the applicant any inconsistencies, failures or irregularities observed in the submitted material. The analysis process is internal, technical and discretionary. Feedback is given exclusively in case of approval.
terms.deadline_text: The applicant will receive email feedback only in case of approval, within up to 10 (ten) calendar days from the submission date. If no communication is received within this period, the application is considered not approved, and this silence is interpreted as tacit rejection, without right to appeal, justification or refund.
terms.fee_text: The fee exclusively covers the work of the Legends technical consultant — analysis of the video, graduation certificate and identification document submitted. Payment is non-refundable, regardless of the evaluation result, and does not constitute a guarantee of approval or participation in any event.
terms.approval_text: Approval in the technical analysis makes the athlete eligible for future call-ups (Matchups or Grand Prix), but does not guarantee participation in the next event or any specific edition. Call-ups are defined by the organization according to technical, sports and production criteria.
terms.image_text: By submitting videos and photos, the applicant authorizes, on a free and non-exclusive basis, the use of their name, image, voice and submitted materials by the organization for internal technical evaluation, institutional event promotion, social media and promotional materials related to Karate Legends.

privacy.collected_text: We collect: full name, email, WhatsApp, city, country, style, graduation, association/dojo, responsible sensei data (when applicable), social media and public links for video, graduation certificate and identification document submitted by the applicant.
privacy.purpose_text: Data is used exclusively for: (i) technical analysis of the registration by the Legends consultant; (ii) communication of results in case of approval; (iii) administrative management of payments and call-ups; (iv) institutional event promotion, in accordance with the image usage authorization given by the applicant.
privacy.legal_text: Processing is based on the express consent of the data subject when checking the acceptance box on the form and on the execution of preliminary procedures related to a contract (art. 7, I and V of Law 13.709/2018).
privacy.sharing_text: Data is not sold. It may be shared with: (i) infrastructure providers (Lovable Cloud / Supabase) for storage; (ii) payment processors; (iii) public authorities, when required by law.
privacy.retention_text: Data is kept while the applicant may be called up for future editions. The data subject may request deletion at any time, subject to legal storage obligations.
privacy.rights_text: The data subject may request at any time: access, correction, anonymization, portability, deletion of data and revocation of consent. Requests must be sent via the official Instagram @karatelegendsleague.
privacy.security_text: We adopt reasonable technical and administrative measures to protect the data. The applicant is responsible for sharing Google Drive links aware that they themselves set public access — the organization is not liable for unauthorized access to links made public by the applicant.
